title: structured output: add CFG + regex constrained-decoding backends and tokenizer edge-case fixes
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Adds CFG and regex constrained decoding backends; fixes tokenizer edge cases affecting regex anchors; exposes structured_output param to OpenAI-compat layer; includes unit and integration tests and performance tuning.
description: Motivation: Add two new constrained-decoding backends (CFG/grammar and regex-based) to support structured_output APIs and improve reliability across tokenizers. This PR implements the backends, plugs them into the constrained-decoding dispatcher used by the OpenAI-compat layer, fixes several tokenizer edge-cases that caused incorrect regex matches (esp. around multi-byte sequences and byte-level token boundaries), and adds tests and perf adjustments. Summary of changes: - New regex-based constrained decoding backend with incremental matching to support streaming constraints. - New CFG/grammar backend that compiles a compact chart representation and supports left-factoring + epsilon rules for robustness. - Tokenizer compatibility fixes: normalization of special tokens, better anchor handling, and fixes for edge-cases where token boundaries split regex capture groups. - OpenAI compatibility: expose structured_output and constraint_backend options via the v1/completions and v1/chat endpoints; maintain backward compatibility with existing streaming hooks. - Tests: unit tests for both backends, tokenizer regression tests based on real reproduction cases, and integration tests exercising streaming + structured validation. - Performance: micro-optimizations in the regex engine and batching path to keep latency in SLO. Checklist: - [x] Implement regex backend - [x] Implement CFG backend - [x] Fix tokenizer edge cases - [x] Expose option in OpenAI-compat layer - [x] Add unit + integration tests - [x] Add basic docs and examples - [x] Run CI and perf regressions Notes: This is intended to be feature-complete but conservative in default behavior: structured_output is opt-in and defaults to the previous unconstrained generator. The regex backend is selected automatically for simple single-pattern constraints; complex grammars default to the CFG backend. See docs/api/structured_output.md for configuration details.

notes: This PR is a mid-size feature addition to structured output. It is opt-in and exposed via the OpenAI-compat layer. QA validated against SUP-342 reproducer and a small internal customer grammar set.
